reminders.title: Reminders
reminder.reset_on_idle: Away from the computer counts as a break — the timer starts over
general.title: General
general.language_hint: Applies after the island restarts: tray icon → “Restart”.
general.show_island: Always show the island (otherwise only during a reminder)
general.monitor_gone: A display that is not connected (the main one for now)
general.fullscreen_hint: The reminder sound plays either way.
general.player: Show what is playing now (music and video from any player)
general.announce_tracks: Show a new track for a few seconds
general.silent_drop: Remove the player if it stays silent
general.live: Live animation when the island is dimmed (bars, track time, timer seconds)
general.live_hint: Otherwise the island freezes. On a laptop, live animation uses a little battery.
general.keep_screen: “Keep awake” also keeps the screen on
general.keep_screen_hint: A button in the control center (pull the island down). Unchecked, the computer stays awake but the screen turns off as usual.
general.animations_hint: For now this is the wave that runs out of the island when an area selection opens.
general.area_marks_hint: Red corners around the picked area, from the pre-start panel to the end of the recording. They never get into the video.
shot.key_hint: A screenshot without the control center. The key is remembered by its place on the keyboard, so the layout doesn't matter. Windows Snipping Tool stays on Win+Shift+S.
shot.area_key_hint: First pick a window or draw a frame on the frozen screen, then the shot is taken. The same as holding the Screenshot button in the control center for half a second. Not set by default.
shot.hint: Take a screenshot with the key above or the control-center button. While the screenshot card is visible: click the text or press Ctrl+C to copy it to the clipboard, press Ctrl+X to put it only in the clipboard with no file, click the thumbnail to open it in the viewer.
viewer.title: Buttons in the viewer window
viewer.strip: On a dark strip at the top, with the file name
viewer.floating: Right on the screenshot, no strip
viewer.hint: “Edit” opens the editor: brush, marker, arrow, frame, pixelate, crop. Without the strip the buttons hide unless you hold the cursor near them. While the window is open the island shows the screenshot: click it to bring the window back, the arrow puts the screenshot back into the island (hold it in the editor). The file stays.
record.key_hint: One key starts and stops recording. Without it, use the “Record” button in the control center.
record.panel_hint: Sound, countdown, quality and codec are in the recording panel: click the Record button in the control center. The island's own sounds are never recorded.
record.hint: The monitor with the island is recorded; the island itself does not appear in the video. While recording, the island shows pause and stop; hover to see the file size and a track with ✕: drag the circle to the edge to delete the recording. After you stop, a card appears: click the thumbnail to open the video, click the text or press Ctrl+C to put the file in the clipboard, Ctrl+X to put it only in the clipboard with no file in the folder.
about.title: About
update.title: Update available
update.installing_hint: The island restarts by itself in a few seconds.
dev.title: For developers
dev.journal_hint: The island logs its start, screen recordings and anything that failed here — with the error code and Windows' answer.
footer.saved_restart: Saved. The language changes after the island restarts.
hotkey.problem_too_plain: {{label}} with only Ctrl, Alt or Shift would take a shortcut away from programs (like Ctrl+S). Add another Shift or Alt — or use PrtSc.
hotkey.problem_busy: {{label}} is already held by another program.
hotkey.same_as_record: This combination is already used by screen recording.
hotkey.same_as_shot: This combination is already used by screenshots.
hotkey.same_as_area: This combination is already used by area screenshots.
hotkey.snipping: PrtSc currently opens Windows Snipping Tool, so the island does not take it.
hotkey.release_failed: Did not work — switch it in Windows settings: Accessibility → Keyboard.
hotkey.recording_hint: Hold Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win and press a key. Esc cancels.
